integrity: Claim and proof are self-contained modulo the explicitly cited standard product identity for reciprocal-gcd sums. Standalone exact-arithmetic checks corroborate but cannot replace infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Historical priority is best-knowledge only. The prime-divisibility two-cycle result is unconditional for positive integers; the reciprocal-gcd corollary requires squarefreeness, and no improvement of the known global counting exponent is claimed.
title: No reciprocal two-cycles for the sixth cyclotomic polynomial
